faq_q1: How do I track my order?
faq_a1: Go to Profile → Order History and open any order to see its live status and delivery updates.
faq_a2: Delivery charges are calculated based on your distance from the store and are shown at checkout before you pay.
faq_q3: How can I cancel my order?
faq_a3: You can cancel an order from the order details page while it is still being prepared. Once it's out for delivery, please contact support.
faq_a4: We accept cash on delivery, digital wallets and online payments, depending on what the store has enabled.
faq_q5: How do I apply a coupon?
faq_a5: Add items to your cart, then enter or select a coupon on the cart or checkout screen to apply the discount.
